nodes.description: Address constant of the EOG ERC20 token contract used for balance lookups.
Contract owner address; set in constructor and guarded by onlyOwner.
Public address of the last maximum EOG holder paid out.
Public address of the last lottery winner paid out.
Minimum EOG token balance required to register and to be counted in the lottery.
Private owner-controlled seed value mixed into the pseudo random generator.
Last ETH value deposited through chargeLottery().
Dynamic array of payable participant addresses eligible for the lottery.
Deployment constructor that sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to a new payable address.
View helper returning the EOG balance of a registered competitor, else 0.
onlyOwner setter for MinEOG and the randomness seed.
View function summing weighted EOG balances of all eligible competitors; result is used as randomness modulus.
Payable function storing msg.value in ChargedETH.
View pseudo-random generator based on block.timestamp, block.difficulty, Competitors.length and seed.
View function returning the competitor with the largest EOG balance.
onlyOwner core payout loop that selects a winner pseudo-randomly and transfers ETH prizes.
Internal view that checks whether an address is already in Competitors.
Public registration function that pushes msg.sender into Competitors if balance and uniqueness checks pass.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and registration.
Miner-influenceable timestamp consumed by the Random generator.
Competitors[i].transfer((address(this).balance/4)*3) external ETH transfer to a caller-registered address.
MaxHold.transfer(address(this).balance) external ETH transfer to the largest EOG holder.
keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty, length, seed) pseudo-randomness that is predictable/miner-influenced.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Address parameter of GetUserPoints.
New minimum EOG value parameter of ChangeMinEog.
New seed value parameter of ChangeMinEog.
Upper bound (modulus) parameter of the Random function.
Address parameter of ExistCompetitor.
Accumulated weighted balance returned by GetPoints.
Local pseudo-random number produced in Random.
Running maximum-holder address in GetMaxHolder.
Random draw used as the winning index in StartLottery.
Cumulative weighted counter used for winner selection.
Per-competitor weighted balance slice in StartLottery.
Payable result of GetMaxHolder() inside StartLottery.

edges.reason: Constructor reads caller address msg.sender to set the original owner.
owner state variable is assigned msg.sender during construction.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner, gating transferOwnership.
_newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into the owner state variable.
_adr parameter is consumed by GetUserPoints.
GetUserPoints iterates over the Competitors array.
GetUserPoints calls balanceOf on the EOGAddress token contract.
onlyOwner modifier restricts ChangeMinEog to the owner.
_newval parameter is consumed by ChangeMinEog.
_seed parameter is consumed by ChangeMinEog.
ChangeMinEog overwrites the MinEOG threshold.
ChangeMinEog overwrites the private seed used by Random.
Local Maxrand accumulates the weighted balances in GetPoints.
GetPoints iterates over the Competitors array.
GetPoints compares each balance against the MinEOG threshold.
GetPoints queries EOG balances via EOGAddress.
chargeLottery stores msg.value into ChargedETH.
max parameter is used as the modulo bound in Random.
block.timestamp is fed into the keccak256 randomness computation.
Random produces a miner-influenceable pseudo-random number via keccak256 of timestamp/difficulty/seed.
Random mixes the owner-controlled seed state variable.
Random uses Competitors.length as entropy input.
local randomnumber holds the value returned by Random.
local MaxHolder tracks the current maximum holder in GetMaxHolder.
GetMaxHolder iterates over the Competitors array.
GetMaxHolder queries EOG balances via EOGAddress.
onlyOwner modifier restricts StartLottery to the contract owner.
StartLottery calls Random(GetPoints()) to pick the winning index.
StartLottery calls GetPoints to compute the randomness modulus.
StartLottery calls GetMaxHolder to determine the maximum-holder payout.
local RandNum holds the random draw used in StartLottery.
local counter accumulates weighted balances during winner selection.
local tempnum holds each competitor's weighted balance slice.
local MaxHold receives the payable result of GetMaxHolder().
StartLottery performs Competitors[i].transfer of 3/4 of the contract balance to a participant.
StartLottery performs MaxHold.transfer of the remaining contract balance before finishing state updates.
A malicious winner contract can re-enter StartLottery during the ETH transfer.
The maximum-holder transfer can re-enter StartLottery while balances are still stale.
StartLottery updates LastLotteryWinner after paying the winner.
StartLottery updates LastMaxWinner after paying the maximum holder.
StartLottery iterates over and reads the Competitors array.
_adr parameter is consumed by ExistCompetitor.
ExistCompetitor scans the Competitors array for a duplicate.
Register uses msg.sender as the address being registered.
Register requires balanceOf(msg.sender) >= MinEOG, a caller-controlled check.
Register pushes msg.sender into the Competitors array.
Register calls ExistCompetitor to prevent duplicate registration.
Register reads the MinEOG threshold for its eligibility requirement.
Register calls balanceOf on the EOGAddress token contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter exists only to be written into the owner state variable by transferOwnership.
The _adr parameter is only used inside the GetUserPoints lookup loop.
The _newval parameter is only assigned to the MinEOG state variable.
The _seed parameter is only assigned to the seed state variable.
The max parameter is only used as the modulo bound inside Random.
The _adr parameter is only compared against the Competitors array inside ExistCompetitor.
Maxrand is a temporary accumulator that is returned directly by GetPoints.
randomnumber is a temporary value returned immediately by Random.
MaxHolder is a temporary address returned directly by GetMaxHolder.
RandNum is a temporary draw used only within the StartLottery selection loop.
counter is a temporary cumulative weight used only inside StartLottery.
tempnum is a temporary per-competitor weight used only inside StartLottery.
MaxHold is the payable target address passed directly into the MaxHold.transfer payout in StartLottery.
